title: A graph planar algebra approach to near-group categories
summary: In this note we investigate the construction of near-group fusion categories via building explicit representations of them in certain graph planar algebras. To achieve this we first give a presentation for a cyclic near-group fusion category. Our presentation is ``subfactor-centric'' in the sense that we use a Q-system as one of our generating morphisms. Using this presentation we then obtain a rational system of equations, a solution of which corresponds to a faithful embedding of a near-group fusion category into a certain 2-coloured graph planar algebra.
